summary: NKGen Biotech filed an 8-K regarding a Third Omnibus Amendment to its Secured Convertible Loan Agreement with AlpineBrook Capital GP I Limited, receiving an additional $2.42 million loan (net $2.2M) convertible at $0.08/share. This is a routine debt financing amendment, not a special-situation event. No change of control, no strategic review, no tender offer, no distribution to shareholders. The filing updates an existing credit facility. What to watch: dilution from conversion at a low fixed price, but no actionable event for special-situations analysis.
